notes.title: Coming Soon: Undo Feature Update
notes.notes:
[p]We are working on one of the most requested features: Undo.[/p][list][*][p]Press Backspace or click the new button near Restart to undo your last move.[/p][/*][*][p]Undo will be unlimited, so you can freely experiment with different paths.[/p][/*][*][p]The old “Lose” screen will be removed. If you get stuck, just undo instead of restarting.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update is planned to arrive in about 10 days.
Stay tuned and thank you for playing 🐍[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701258/00f7a3a2b2c4d95e23082ccc6da3ec862881b2fd.png"][/img][/p]
